title: Set up with another device
intro: On a computer that already has Password365, open {place}. Then paste the pairing code it shows here. Both computers must be on the same network.
check: Type this code on the other device:
waiting: Waiting for approval on the other device…
approved: Approved. Enter the master password you use on the other device, and give this device a name. Your items arrive right after.
showIntro: On the device that has your vault (your phone or another computer), open {place} and scan this code. Both devices must be on the same network.
showPlace: Devices › Add a device › Scan the new device's code
showQr: QR code to join this vault
showWaiting: Waiting for the other device to scan… The code works once and expires in 5 minutes.
pasteInstead: Or paste a code from the other device
noWifi: This phone is not on Wi-Fi. Connect it to the same Wi-Fi network as the other device, then try again.
timeoutHint: Could not reach the other device. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi network (not mobile data or a guest network), that Password365 is open on the other device, and that its firewall allows connections.
